# VmMaintenance

> PowerShell fleet console (Windows, PS 5.1/7) for server maintenance before in-place OS upgrades, (the Manager) plus an Extractor (PS 2.0+) run inside RDP that leaves an encrypted result file to copy back. Environment-agnostic: no hosts, IPs, IDs or credentials in the repository.

Rules an assistant must keep when changing this code:
- One function per file; Public/ = exported, Private/ = internal; noun prefix Vmm.
- ASCII-only source; CRLF for .ps1/.psm1/.psd1/.cs/.sql (PS 5.1 reads BOM-less files as ANSI).
- Never store usernames, passwords or tokens. Credentials live only in $script:VmmCredentials for the session.
- Never put real environment values in the repo; they live in %APPDATA%\VmMaintenance\config.psd1.
- Errors: throw (New-VmmErrorRecord -Activity -Target -Exception -Cause -Fix -ErrorId 'Vmm...').
- OS policy (Get-VmmHostPolicy): target Windows Server 2019; client OS untouched unless ordered; warn management on Server 2008 non-R2 and physical; disk expand after hours only.
- Host changes go through Assert-VmmWindow (Lisbon business hours: checks + staging only).
- Mark security decisions with [SEC] comments; planned extensions with TODO-FUTURE.
- Regenerate FunctionsToExport in VmMaintenance.psd1 when adding a Public file.

## Code entry points
- [Scripts/vmm.ps1](Scripts/vmm.ps1): CLI/TUI entry, global flags, exit codes
- [VmMaintenance/Public/Invoke-VmmCli.ps1](VmMaintenance/Public/Invoke-VmmCli.ps1): command map
- [VmMaintenance/Public/Invoke-VmmWorkflowStep.ps1](VmMaintenance/Public/Invoke-VmmWorkflowStep.ps1): step engine
- [VmMaintenance/Public/Start-VmmRemoteHandoff.ps1](VmMaintenance/Public/Start-VmmRemoteHandoff.ps1): hands-on staging over RDP/RDM/RDCMan with verification (Get-VmmHandoffEvidence)
- [VmMaintenance/Resources/Fallback/VmmFallback.ps1](VmMaintenance/Resources/Fallback/VmmFallback.ps1): standalone last fallback on a host (no vmm, no key), data in VmmFallback.psd1
- [VmMaintenance/Resources/VmmHostAgent.ps1](VmMaintenance/Resources/VmmHostAgent.ps1): program 2 (remote host)
- [VmMaintenance/Private/Add-VmmLogEntry.ps1](VmMaintenance/Private/Add-VmmLogEntry.ps1): every log line (live pane buffer + encrypted day log)
- [VmMaintenance/Public/Invoke-VmmMaintenance.ps1](VmMaintenance/Public/Invoke-VmmMaintenance.ps1): maintenance of vmm itself
- [VmMaintenance/Private/Resolve-VmmHostWorkflow.ps1](VmMaintenance/Private/Resolve-VmmHostWorkflow.ps1): a ticket's workflow, step states and rules (Get-VmmWorkflowCatalog = built-ins + workflows.vmm)
- [VmMaintenance/Resources/VmmRunbook.ps1](VmMaintenance/Resources/VmmRunbook.ps1): host runbook template (PS 2.0+, data block replaced by Get-VmmRunbookScript)
- [PROJECT.json](PROJECT.json): machine-readable summary
